app.title: Qanoun
app.description: Browse Moroccan law and ask questions — answers grounded in official texts.
app.footer: An open-source project combining data engineering, AI and Moroccan law.

home.heroSubtitle: Family Code, Labour Code, the D.O.C. and more — read, indexed and question-ready.
home.askPlaceholder: Ask anything: marriage, divorce, work contract, lease…
home.topicsSubtitle: Start where it matters to you
home.how1Body: Official texts are fetched, Arabic PDFs parsed, segmented into articles and stored with a vector index.
home.how2Body: Semantic + full-text search fused together: the right article even when the question is in Darija.
home.how3Body: The AI answers only from retrieved passages, with a citation to the exact article.
home.disclaimer: Informational only — not legal advice. The official bulletin remains the reference.

errors.unreachable: No AI model is reachable. Add a free key (for example QANOUN_GEMINI_KEY) to .env and restart the API, or start LM Studio / Ollama.
errors.auth: The API key was rejected. Check it in .env and restart the API.
errors.rate_limit: The AI provider's rate limit was hit. Wait a minute or choose another provider in ⚙ settings.
errors.model: That model isn't available from this provider. Choose another one in ⚙ settings.
errors.empty: The model returned an empty answer. Try again or choose another model in ⚙ settings.
errors.interrupted: The answer was cut off. Ask again.
errors.retrieval: Searching the laws failed. Check that the database is running (make db).
errors.network: Couldn't reach the Qanoun API. Start it with make api.
errors.error: Something went wrong while answering. Try again.
errors.unavailable: The AI provider is busy right now. Try again in a moment, or choose another model in ⚙ settings.

chat.noHistory: Your questions will be saved here, in this browser.
chat.stopped: Stopped — this answer may be incomplete.
chat.panelHint: Click a citation like [1] in an answer to read the full article here.
